properties.definition: Every maximal behavior of the deployed bytes, under the modeled environment, is related by the stated value/store/error/observation relation to a behavior of the source program P, and P satisfies its application contract C. Partial correctness unless a separate termination claim is made.
properties.not_implied_by: Not implied by agreement on a test corpus, by successful return of sampled runs, or by a theorem about a reference model rather than the executable implementation.

properties.definition: No execution of the deployed program reads or writes memory outside objects it owns under the native representation relation; no use-after-free, out-of-bounds or type-confused access, including during allocation and collection.
properties.not_implied_by: Not implied by functional correctness of results, since an unsafe access may not change a sampled result.

properties.definition: The program and the certificate checker can invoke only the capabilities granted by the admission profile (for the sealed checker: the seventeen listed bindings); no eval, load, FFI or file authority is reachable unless granted.
properties.not_implied_by: Not implied by memory safety or by functional correctness for admitted inputs.

properties.definition: Every behavior from admitted inputs is finite under explicit scheduling and input-availability premises. Fuel-bounded evaluation returning unknown is never evidence of termination or divergence.
properties.not_implied_by: Not implied by partial correctness, fuel monotonicity or finite trace inclusion.

properties.definition: Under stated fairness/eventual-delivery premises, required observable events eventually occur (temporal properties in SEM-TEMPORAL).
properties.not_implied_by: Not implied by termination of individual calls nor by safety trace inclusion.

properties.definition: Information-flow property: observations available to a declared low observer are independent of declared secret inputs, including timing/resource channels only where explicitly claimed.
properties.not_implied_by: Not implied by confinement or memory safety; a confined program may still leak through allowed outputs.

properties.definition: The deployment profile provides enough heap, stack, file descriptors and time for the claimed behaviors; modeled resource failure is reported distinctly.
properties.not_implied_by: Not implied by functional correctness, which treats resource failure as a separate observation.

profile_differences.enforced_at: shen/klambda.shen buri.saturated? via buri.expression? (BURI/KL-PURE-1 reference admission only; native ports do not enforce this difference)
profile_differences.difference: KLambda curries an under-saturated primitive call and over-applies the result of an over-saturated one; BURI/KL-PURE-1 [primitive Op Args] syntax is a saturated direct call, other arities are rejected at admission ([rejected ...]); buri.eval itself raises primitive-domain-or-arity for them and its refinement theorems cover only saturated calls. Currying of user functions ([global F], [function ...] values) is supported and proved (KLambdaEvaluatorExtended.klambda_refines_ext).
